- Each conversation now remembers the agent mode you picked, including chats started from the API or the AI Manager.
- Agents can connect apps that sign in through the browser right from a chat.
- Long Claude conversations and scheduled routines start replying faster.
- Agents can send your workspace files to connected apps, and tell you exactly which permission an app needs.
- Connected AI accounts recover on their own when a sign-in expires, and Gemini 4 Neon is now available.
